- Further steps are unlikely ...

case.summary: The alert was triggered when the real-time model scored transaction 3523199, an online purchase of $100.07 on product R, with a risk score of 0.54. The strongest findings are that the model risk score of 0.54 corresponds to a calibrated fraud rate of 5 % for product R transactions in this score band, and the same amount ($99.92, product R) was previously charged on this card on 2016-07-15. The case was judged legitimate with a fraud probability of 0.09. The recommended actions are to allow the transaction and close the case with no fraud finding.
